description: Accept only unchanged pinned upstream optional-feature, historical-runtime, platform, resource, or explicit upstream limitation guards. Missing core preparation inputs and unexplained skips fail.

condition_contract.missing_or_unsupported: reject; inequality never accepts an absent fact
condition_contract.always: only an exact explicit pinned upstream skip or a project functional-scope exclusion, with exact suite/case/group scope
condition_contract.runtime_equals: runtime-facts.json field equals value (booleans may be native JSON or atom strings)
condition_contract.runtime_not_equals: existing runtime-facts.json field differs from value
condition_contract.tool_absent: tool is absent from the exact isolated controller PATH; do not infer from source alone
condition_contract.modules_absent: every listed optional module absent in the candidate image; property_tools must be known empty
condition_contract.memory_below: candidate memsup available_memory, then total_memory, then system_total_memory in bytes divided by 2**30 is below minimum_gb (sanitizer_minimum_gb for asan/valgrind; debug_scale multiplies minimum_gb when debug_compiled is true); prefer event resource_memory; undefined or missing memsup rejects; an optional inclusive flag permits equality only where the source uses a strict greater-than run guard
condition_contract.old_release_absent: the supplied optional_releases inventory contains no historical runtime matching release_regex; no implicit PATH lookup or fallback
condition_contract.paths_absent: on the specified platform every listed upstream probe path is absent
condition_contract.platform_equals: the configured native platform matches value
condition_contract.runtime_one_of: existing runtime-facts.json/event guard_facts field is one of the declared values
condition_contract.event_guard_facts: overlay event.guard_facts on startup runtime facts; these are measured from the candidate at each user skip and do not alter test state
condition_contract.memory_components_below: require actual event resource_memory without resource_memory_error, every required_components key present, and the sum of listed components (optional missing keys zero) below threshold_gb * 2**30; matches distribution free_memory/0
condition_contract.all: every nested condition matches; used where one upstream guard tests more than one runtime fact

event_scope_contract: case/group/callback, when present, are exact event selectors; guard_callback documents the source origin. A suite/group guard may justify downstream user skips only with its matching observed guard origin; never reinterpret tc_auto_skip as accepted user skip.
class_contract: scope rules are explicit functional exclusions and are reported separately from runtime skips. A scope rule uses condition always and matches one emulator_scope.json exclusion.

    case ?MODULE of
        bs_match_int_no_opt_SUITE ->
            %% This test case is written with the assumption that
            %% bs_skip2 instructions are used when the value of the
            %% extracted segment will not be used. In OTP 21 and earlier, that
            %% assumption was always true, because the bs_skip optimization
            %% was included in v3_codegen and could not be disabled.
            %% In OTP 22, the bs_skip optimization is done by beam_ssa_opt

            %% instructions may cause the runtime system to terminate
            %% because of insufficient memory.
            {skip, "unoptimized code would use too much memory"};
        bs_match_int_SUITE ->
            do_match_huge_int();
        bs_match_int_stripped_types_SUITE ->
            do_match_huge_int()

rules.reason_regex: ^Failed to find any known zero-sized files$
rules.guard:
%% ensuring that response isn't empty << >>
proc_zero_sized_files(Config) when is_list(Config) ->
    TestFiles0 = [%% Some files which exist on Linux but might be missing on
                  %% other systems
                  "/proc/cpuinfo",
                  "/proc/meminfo",
                  "/proc/partitions",
                  "/proc/swaps",
                  "/proc/version",
                  "/proc/uptime",
                  %% curproc is present on FreeBSD
                  "/proc/curproc/cmdline"],

    TestFiles = [F || F <- TestFiles0, filelib:is_file(F)],

    case TestFiles of
        [_|_] ->
            %% For 6 inputs and 500 attempts each this do run anywhere
            %% between 500 and 3000 function calls.
            [do_proc_zero_sized(F, 500) || F <- TestFiles],
            ok;
        [] ->
            {skip, "Failed to find any known zero-sized files"}
    end.
